name: Discord TLO (Token Leak/Takeover) Exploit
description: Comprehensive Discord security testing framework for token validation, account enumeration, webhook exploitation, and token extraction. Features verbose mode with detailed API call logging, progress tracking, and vulnerability analysis. AUTHORIZED TESTING ONLY.
author: NullSec Team

parameters.name: attack_mode
parameters.description: Select the Discord attack vector to execute

parameters.name: target_user
parameters.description: Target Discord user ID or username (optional)

parameters.name: extract_path
parameters.description: Path to search for Discord tokens (default: common locations)

parameters.name: stealth_mode
parameters.description: Enable stealth mode (skip sensitive API calls)

parameters.name: verbose_mode
parameters.description: Enable verbose mode with detailed API logging and statistics

examples.desc: Token Validation: Validates a Discord token and extracts user information
Token Extract: Searches common Discord directories for leaked tokens
Webhook Exploit: Tests and exploits Discord webhooks for message injection
Full Enumeration: Complete account takeover reconnaissance
Verbose Mode: Run any attack with detailed API logging (options 5-8)
